mapper.select: SELECT user_id, tenant_id, user_name, nick_name, email, dept_id, status, deleted, version FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = '0' AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT account.user_id FROM sys_user account WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND account.user_id > #{afterUserId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role membership JOIN sys_role role ON role.role_id = membership.role_id AND role.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND role.status = '0' AND role.deleted = 0 AND role.role_key = 'admin' WHERE membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND membership.user_id = account.user_id ) ORDER BY account.user_id LIMIT #{limit}
